notes.title: Update 1.2 The Wizard Update
notes.content:
A new Hero has arrived in the village of Millford – but this one doesn’t carry a sword or shield. Instead, they bring a library of ancient knowledge and arcane might. Introducing classes — and with it, the Wizard!

🧙‍♂️ The Wizard brings a whole new style of gameplay, focused on spellcasting, clever combos, and managing magical energy. Whether you prefer blasting foes from afar or controlling the battlefield with status effects, this class opens up powerful new strategies.

🃏 New Cards
We’ve added several new cards to expand your tactical options:

Parry – Deflecting enemy attacks
Battering Ram – Knocking down your opponents and leaving them vulnerable
Flaming Arrow – Ignite foes from a distance with burning precision.
Blinding Light – Blind and disrupt your enemies with radiant energy.


 Improved Graphics quality
 Adding Warriror Class - with balancing changes
 Adding Wizard Class
 New Card - Parry
 New Card - Battering Ram
 New Card - Flaming Arrow
 New Card - Blinding Light
 New Monster conditions Blindness & Knockdown

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Based on some player feedback here are some updates to the initial build to help with playability.


 Fixed issues running on older hardware
 Improved Tutorial
 Increased text readabiity in several locations
 Improved UI interactivity & tooltips
 Gain experience as soon as you play a card rather than at end of battle
 Increased experience reward to reach level 2 faster
 Option to choose between 2 cards when levelling up
 Update to music


Hope you enjoy the updates.
Keep the feedback coming.
